claim_summary: For a fixed perfect matching in the balanced three-part graph \(K_{2m,2m,2m}\), its avoidance probability is \(e^{-3/4}(1+3/(128m^2)+O(m^{-3}))\) as \(m\to\infty\).
integrity: This mathematical claim was reconstructed and checked with a standalone exact rational verifier; finite checks do not replace the asymptotic proof. No independent mathematical audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The prior literature proves the limit and provides the exact inclusion-exclusion series. This work isolates its first nonzero asymptotic correction. Only the zero-overlap probability is treated; effective finite remainder constants, full-distribution rates, and publication priority beyond inspected records are not established.
title: A vanished first correction for tripartite deranged matchings
